title: A page router
hints: Split both into parts with `path.split("/").filter(Boolean)`. A route matches when it has as many parts and each part is equal or starts with `:`.
`link` finds the route by name and replaces each `:name` part with `params[name]`.
requirements: A `:name` part matches any one non-empty part and is stored in `params`. A trailing `/` is ignored.
The first matching route wins; nothing matching gives `not-found`.
`link(page, params)` builds a path back from a page name.
stretch: Connect it to a page: listen for `popstate` and clicks on links, and call `history.pushState`.
